method: Bounded static review of the exact controller and its new candidate admission/CLI/runner path; independently re-ran mocked runner and scratch-Git admission tests. Controller was not executed, and no real ledger/auth/provider/model outputs were read. Reviewer authored JSON transport/admission integration but not this controller, allocation cases or semantic engine.

findings.issue: Controller prepare originally bound independent audit only by source fingerprint, permitting a different-seed corpus audit under the same source.
findings.verifiedRepair: prepare now additionally requires audit.fullCorpusHash===hash(tasks). Current independent audit fullCorpusHash and datasetHash both equal the actual 4334b018 corpus.

verifiedControls: Canonical repository cwd derived from controller file; existing authoritative cap75 ledger and registered reservation floor, no initialize/reset.
Prepare requires current source/corpus engineering audit, runtime and cross-provider reviews; exact controller SHA approved and byte-identical durable copy.

All four fixed development profiles use exact configured OpenAI models, baseline,20turns,16384inclusive output,600s transport,JSON-object response. Caller CLI binds selected content/IDs/alias/config/harness/limits and atomic one-time receipt claim before Budget.

Prospective whole-plan affordability before registration and every remaining forecast before dispatch. Cost/provider/budget/model/process overrun flags halt subsequent calls; per-call shared Budget preserves cap.
Run binds committed registration/audit/reviews/plan/controller/all immutable runner SOURCE_FILES byte-for-byte using explicit repository-root git.
Serial predecessor requires terminal-native-run, complete coverage, no process/provider/model/spend flags and exact retained native bytes. Existing receipt prevents duplicate panel dispatch.
New run validation binds generation/responseFormat/dataset/model/taskIDs/harness/repeat/limits; raw native file is retained without overwrite.

Current registration template contains no holdout panels, so stage holdout fails before controller lock/output directory/child invocation. Future holdouts require new committed registration/release plus independent development audit and bound committed development dispatch receipts.
Truncation is recorded even after recovery and bars clean comparisons; controller may continue fixed panels under this declared observation policy. It does not repair or selectively rerun outputs.

verification.evidence: Actual mocked runner six-development oracles and same-batch post-finish intent critical-zero control passed; scratch-Git admission positive/negative controls passed. No paid transport or controller invocation.

limitations: Controller review is engineering admission only; registration, committed freeze and cross-provider review are separate gates.

Forecast6.25 is an estimate, not a guaranteed complete-panel cost or invoice; no real current balance was independently read. Shared hard cap and remaining-plan checks protect admitted calls, with terminal limitations retained.
No real child dispatch or external transport was exercised. Exact current-source mocked tests and static guard review support the scope stated.
This review does not approve a future holdout registration/controller amendment or establish difficulty, expert validity or clean empirical comparisons.
